supersedes: Blank-click reveal and immediate arrow rotation in the earlier local-ui-validation.json are superseded by no click behavior and an interruptible 160ms rotation.

safari.conditions: Safari 27.0 on macOS, native app operated with cua_repl. Animation frames sampled through the built-in Web Inspector. Inspector resized the page height but not its width. Desktop testing only.

nativeActions.visualInspection: Navigation and reading header checked in Safari; title no longer has Aa.

safari.interpretation: Layout centering reduces measured center drift during width changes from 0.2421875 CSS px to 0.00781 CSS px. Relayout at 70 ms no longer resets the width spring. A reverse at 70 ms retains the current velocity and returns to navigation width.
